title: Replacing groups of tiles on a map

posts.author: evilmateryoda
posts.body:
Issue: I want to add a feature In my game you can purchase up to 3 lots in each town and choose 1 of 10 different shops/schools to build.  I need to be able to replace a for sale sign or a destroyed building with a new building.  3 times on a single map (sometimes 4) in about 25 different towns/cities.
I'm using RPG maker MZ, I've used in the past XP and ACE
Before Repairs
afte repairs
So I've figured out how to Easly replace a single tile on a map using an event to display that tile then change it with a new image after the event conditions is completed.
I've also got down completely how if on a map I would like something to change, I can create a new map nearly identical to that map with the repaired building, however if I want it to be dynamically available to do it any order ,the more lots I have for sale the more maps I have to create and maintain. Like if I have 4 lots that's 16 different maps I have to maintain just for that one town times 25 towns I could be looking at 400 maps just for the town and that's not including the fact that each building can be 10 different maps. Anyways a custom map is not going to be a option.
My solution I so far that I have came up with is to watch a global variable that I name Cont1Town1Lot1 and have then have events on each spot of the house that I want to be damaged and then have it watch for that variable to get the event updated and then make the damage disappear.  This will use basically 50 of the variables in my game.  Small potatoes I think I'll be using nearly 2000 already.
This works technically but it seems janky and I wanted to see if there is a better solution.  I would also like to have just a empty lot that I can move around in go get a house built and then I can't move around it anymore.  But House tiles/walls are not available in the event tile sets I can't find out how to add more images to the event images.
I did not see anything in the Event Documentation, the Asset Standards doesn't tell you which one is the event's images that display on the map like Tileset_B adn Tileset_C and every time I search how to add custom images to events it's just how to add an image to an event from this existing list.    I basically want the walls and roof tiles available as images to event build a house if I need to.  Unless there is a better way to do that.  If I can get the house assets too appear in this, I can let my players choose the wall material and roof color and set it so I can switch it for a fee like 250 gold to change it.  But I'm just not figuring this out and its got to be very simple to update this to have the other tilesets

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
